villain.name: Max Vathen
villain.known: A billionaire has bought an island nation and is building something on it.
villain.forces: Private security, a fleet, more money than several states.

parts.label: Inscrutable
parts.text: Their goals can be understood; their reasons cannot. Madness, or a mind that does not work like yours.

parts.label: Corrupted Organization
parts.text: Once legitimate - a firm, an agency, a government body - and since turned, probably by the villain.

parts.label: Mini-Ruler
parts.text: A minor villain in their own right, running a domain of their own.

parts.label: Specialist
parts.text: Extremely good at one thing, which is the thing they are here for.

parts.label: A Little Different
parts.text: Unusual in some flavourful way - a signature weapon, a way of dressing.

parts.label: Fight Club
parts.text: Whatever else they are for, what they want is to fight the player character.

parts.label: Fight Club
parts.text: Whatever else they are for, what they want is to fight the player character.

parts.label: Soldier
parts.text: A soldier, probably one of many, ready to fight for the villain.

parts.label: Groveler
parts.text: Defined by their subservience - the one who agrees with everything.

parts.label: Family Tie
parts.text: Related to the villain, or close to them in some personal way.

parts.label: As Expected
parts.text: Exactly what this villain and this organization would produce. Build them to fit the need in front of you.
